sources.title: qwen3.7-flash model information
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Exact-model specification identifies native vision-language Qwen3.7 Flash and compares improved multimodal and agent capabilities with 3.6-Flash. It supplies no total/active parameter count, dense/MoE topology, or explicit size-bearing base-model relationship. The July 15 snapshot is listed; the documented comparison alone does not establish unchanged model structure.

sources.title: Qwen3.7-Flash
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Exact-model first-party page describes the native vision-language model as an upgrade over 3.6-Flash, with image/text/video input, text output and thinking support. No total/active count or explicit base checkpoint is stated.

sources.title: Model pricing
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Official pricing maps qwen3.7-flash capabilities to qwen3.7-flash-2026-07-15. The mapping identifies the API snapshot; neither identifier has a published parameter count in this table.

sources.title: Model Studio Beijing model console
sources.evidence: Direct page returned only Loading. A partial search-index excerpt displayed Qwen3.7-Flash followed by an unlabeled 2026-07-20 date. Its date meaning and timezone could not be verified; recorded as a conflict, not substituted for the explicit July 21 release-table entry.

sources.title: Models.dev qwen3.7-flash record
sources.evidence: Baseline catalog dates the model July 15 and calls it lightweight/high-throughput. This establishes the assertions under review, not independent technical verification.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model card and benchmark comparison
sources.evidence: Checked October 27, 2026 for later total and activated parameter disclosures. The developer comparison table lists Qwen3.7-Plus at 397B total and 17B activated, alongside Qwen3.8 and DeepSeek models. It does not list Qwen3.7-Flash; the Plus count cannot be transferred across tiers. The explicit named-base relationship on this card concerns Qwen3.8-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, not the audited 3.7-Flash.

sources.title: Text generation models and capability comparison
sources.evidence: October 15 documentation, reopened October 27, includes qwen3.7-flash in the recommended-model comparison. Its columns cover context, thinking and tools, with no total or active parameter column and no named-base relationship.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 and Qwen3.7 model selection comparison (community article)
sources.evidence: September 8 user-contributed article, checked October 27 as a search lead only. The page explicitly says registered users contribute its content. Its table marks Qwen3.7-Flash total and activated parameters as undisclosed while asserting a lightweight MoE without an exact-model primary citation. Neither that topology claim nor neighboring model counts establish a specification for this model.

name.note: Display spelling preserves the baseline; official branding also uses Qwen3.7-Flash.

developer.note: Alibaba Cloud publishes the exact Qwen model and its release documentation.

family.note: Explicitly identified as the Qwen3.7 native vision-language Flash series.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit public release found is July 21 in both Beijing and Singapore tables. July 15 is a snapshot date. Unlabeled console-index July 20 metadata remains unresolved; later reseller and US-scope dates are not the original release.

open_weights.note: The exact model card documents the hosted Flash API. The developer Qwen3.7 weight inventory is empty and no exact Flash release was found. Classified closed under the public-download availability rule at review time; an explicit proprietary declaration is not required.

license.note: Reviewed primary model pages provide no model-weight license; API service terms are not a weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh primary-source review found no published nominal total for Qwen3.7-Flash. The explicit mapping is to its July 15 API snapshot; improved capabilities versus 3.6-Flash do not identify a named base or unchanged structure. Later Qwen3.8 comparison tables disclose Qwen3.7-Plus, not Flash, so neither predecessor nor sibling counts apply.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate nominal activated-parameter count was found for Qwen3.7-Flash. The later developer table has an explicit activated-parameter row for Qwen3.7-Plus but no Flash column. No topology or size-bearing lineage supports an inference for this model.

architecture.note: Native vision-language describes modality, not dense/MoE topology. No primary topology or checkpoint mapping was found.

context_window.note: Official context window is exactly 1,000,000 tokens; the smaller maximum input length is a separate limit.

modalities.note: Explicit input/output capability table for the exact API identifier.

reasoning.note: Thinking-mode limits and exact-model enable_thinking example establish reasoning support.

description.value: Qwen3.7 vision-language model supporting text, image, and video inputs, text output, thinking mode, and function calling, with a 1,000,000-token context window.
description.note: Replace unsupported size/throughput characterization with documented capabilities.

patch.description: Qwen3.7 vision-language model supporting text, image, and video inputs, text output, thinking mode, and function calling, with a 1,000,000-token context window.
patch.notes: July 21, 2026 is the earliest explicit Model Studio release-table date found in both Beijing and Singapore; July 15 is the named snapshot date. A partially indexed console shows an unlabeled July 20 date, whose meaning/timezone remains unresolved. Total and active parameters remain undisclosed: the capability comparison with 3.6-Flash establishes no size-bearing base, and later Qwen3.7-Plus counts do not apply to Flash. Dense/MoE architecture and weight license remain unestablished. No public Flash weight release is available. Official pricing maps the alias to the July 15 API snapshot. Classified as closed weights: no public release of this hosted variant was found in the developer documentation and weight inventory.
